package rulefixtures

// scenario for type_switch_vs_repeated_assertions: multiple sequential `if _, ok := i.(T1); ok { ... } else if _, ok := i.(T2); ok { ... }` patterns
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario689Positive(v interface{}) string {
	if _, ok := v.(int); ok {
		return "int"
	} else if _, ok := v.(string); ok {
		return "string"
	} else if _, ok := v.(float64); ok {
		return "float64"
	} else if _, ok := v.([]byte); ok {
		return "bytes"
	}
	return "unknown"
}
